01 / ABOUT

Behind the camera.

Miami, Florida
Available worldwide

Trevor Owens is a Miami-based Director of Photography and 1st Assistant Camera with over seven years of experience in documentary, branded content, music videos, and live events.

His work blends technical control with a natural visual rhythm, shaped by years spent editing and pulling focus on fast-paced sets.

He has worked with clients including Disney, Nickelodeon, CBS Sports, Film 45, and the NFL Network. Known for his reliability and calm presence, he’s experienced with ARRI, Sony Cinema Line, and RED systems, and has supported camera teams on everything from national broadcasts to intimate docuseries. On smaller projects, he often steps into the role of DP, using limited resources to create visuals that feel grounded and expressive.

Originally from a working-class suburb of Chicago, Trevor relocated frequently growing up after his stepfather joined the military. He was diagnosed with Type 1 diabetes at age 12, and these early experiences shaped both his resourcefulness and his ability to adapt under pressure — skills that have translated directly to his work in production. After leaving film school due to cost, he built his career from the ground up in Miami: starting as a PA, then freelancing full-time, and gradually moving up in the camera department while continuing to develop his eye as a cinematographer.

He draws influence from history, engineering, and music — finding rhythm in structure and story in subtle visual choices. His goal isn’t just to make a nice image, but to create something that feels honest, emotionally clear, and made in collaboration with the people around him.
